evidence.alignment: All six technologies target the AI semiconductor domain with market booms clustered in 2026-2029, well aligned with the 2030 reference horizon. The selection covers the full stack from materials and lithography to advanced packaging and architecture, capturing high-growth segments of the AI chip market.
evidence.sequencing: Dependency chains are respected without violation: T03 precedes T01, T02 precedes T04, and T04 precedes T06. However, 칩렛 헤테로지니어스 통합 completes in 2029-Q2, two full years after its market boom in 2027-Q2, indicating a meaningful late-to-market risk for that node.
evidence.investment: Strategic tier is correctly assigned to the highest-TRL, highest-urgency foundational technologies (EUV, High-k), while lower-TRL, higher-uncertainty technologies (Backside PDN, 칩렛) are placed at Medium tier. The gradient from Strategic → High → Medium maps cleanly onto declining urgency and executability scores.
evidence.coherence: The roadmap tells a coherent process-scaling story: foundational materials and lithography enable advanced transistor architectures (GAA), which in turn enable next-generation packaging (hybrid bonding, chiplets) and power delivery (Backside PDN), forming a clear research-to-deployment progression.
evidence.balance: The portfolio spans TRL 3 to TRL 8, distributes risk across process, material, equipment, packaging, and architecture categories, and covers near-term (2026) to long-term (2029+) horizons. Two Strategic, two High, and two Medium tiers provide reasonable tier diversity, though no Exploratory/Low tier is present.

strengths: Zero dependency violations with a logically ordered sequence from enabling materials and lithography through to advanced packaging and power delivery.
Investment tiers are well-calibrated to urgency and executability scores, with Strategic capital concentrated on mature, high-leverage foundational technologies.
weaknesses: 칩렛 헤테로지니어스 통합 is scheduled to complete two years after its market boom (2027-Q2), risking loss of first-mover advantage in a high-growth architectural segment.
No Exploratory or Low-tier technologies are included, leaving the portfolio without optionality for post-2030 disruptions or hedge positions.
missing_technologies: 3D IC 적층 메모리 통합 (HBM/3D-DRAM integration) — critical for AI accelerator memory bandwidth
광인터커넥트 / 실리콘 포토닉스 — emerging interconnect for multi-chiplet and disaggregated AI systems
저전력 SRAM / 뉴로모픽 메모리 — important for on-chip inference efficiency in AI semiconductors
investment_issues: 칩렛 헤테로지니어스 통합은 strategic_fit=4.0으로 높지만 Medium 티어에 배치되어 있어, 2027년 붐을 선점하려면 투자 상향 또는 일정 단축이 필요함.
전체 예산 소진이 0으로 기록되어 있어 예산 배분 실행 계획의 구체성이 확인되지 않음 — 티어별 예산 상한 설정이 필요함.
timing_issues: 칩렛 헤테로지니어스 통합: 완료 시점(2029-Q2)이 시장 붐(2027-Q2)보다 2년 늦어 시장 적기 진입 실패 위험.
하이브리드 본딩: 완료 시점(2027-Q4)이 시장 붐(2027-Q1)보다 0.75년 지연되어 경쟁사 대비 후발 진입 가능성.
GAA 나노시트 공정: 완료 시점(2028-Q1)이 시장 붐(2027-Q3)보다 약 0.5년 늦어 미세한 타이밍 미스 존재.
